question: Does the s047a cell-filter ranking still pick the near-truth cell at s019's 97-cell bracket density on the binding fast-|omega| seed 14?
hypothesis: Cell-filter score-rank works as a top-K cell selector even at fine bracket density where many cells sit 1-3% from truth.
narrative_md: Decisive negative: at s019's 97-cell density on fast-|omega| seed 14, the closest-to-truth cell ranks 34/97 by max_geo (saturated at 1.0 across the top 33 cells), 59/97 by max_align, 81/97 by n_pass_both. The s047a top-1/top-2 headline was gross-mismatch elimination on a 5-cell bracket, not fine ranking. Closes the rank-then-densify-by-cell-filter architecture; pivots s047 to LS-peak-prior + local densification. Uses the closest-to-truth cell as the gate target.
